name: Epoch AI
summary: A research nonprofit, led by Jaime Sevilla, that tracks and forecasts the trajectory of AI: public databases of AI models, compute, chips and data centres, capability benchmarks (FrontierMath, the Epoch Capabilities Index), research reports and a newsletter, used by governments, journalists and researchers. It began in 2022 as a project fiscally sponsored by Rethink Priorities and became an independent US charity (Epoch Artificial Intelligence Inc, EIN 99-4050541, San Francisco) in early 2025; most of its money comes from Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy), with some paid work for AI companies, investors and governments.

spending.source: https://epoch.ai/blog/epoch-impact-report-2025 (Epoch Impact Report 2025, '2025 in numbers': 'Spent $5 million', total spending, the report giving no programme split; no audited statement or Form 990 for 2025 is public yet, and its only return, a Form 990-EZ for 2024, spent $84,231 while the year's work still ran through its fiscal sponsor, Rethink Priorities)

lines.label: Data, benchmarks, research and consultations on the trajectory of AI (every programme)
lines.source: https://epoch.ai/blog/epoch-impact-report-2025 (Epoch Impact Report 2025: data explorers, benchmarks and evaluations, reports and newsletters, 13 commissioned projects and consultations, $5 million in all, no split published; the 2024 Form 990-EZ, Part III, lists one programme, published research on AI progress and scaling trends). One line because charityevals models all of it as one catastrophic-risk model.
